event_pointer_joins.limits: Path equality corroborates producer coordinates, not independent examples, successful dispatch, identical bytes or semantic labels. Repeated paths may overwrite earlier byte versions.

current_source_policy_method: Source-reviewed routing pools, exact complete current first-message template equivalence, including variants generated by config._inject_nothink_directive / config._set_reasoning_directive (no wrapper clipping); no semantic labels. Unmatched historical/role-merged bodies unresolved, not negative examples. Multi-slot extraction NOT asserted. Routing pools overlap for multiplexed phases; do not add them.

matrix_semantics.model_axis: declared suite coder, explicit aliases canonicalized; NOT authenticated judge teacher weights
matrix_semantics.programming_language_axis: suite task-language association, NOT per-candidate content language
matrix_semantics.unlisted_rows: zero current-template observations within reviewed routing pools; NOT proof of absent semantic coverage or hidden historical templates
matrix_semantics.raw_candidate_identity: full UTF8 decoded slot; exact identity only, no near-duplicate/independent-lineage claim
matrix_semantics.public_pair: nonempty nominal content/tool_calls, no native generation-incomplete/error; NOT privacy/safety/semantic/native-format certification

exposure_limits: Not exhaustive: prior replay20, supplied selected controls, ancestor tasks/templates, Main history and other research inspection are exposed too. Read docs/training/main-review.md and original review receipts. Do not treat an unlisted path as untouched.
